Class Car

java.lang.Object
Car
public class Car extends Object
A car with a fuel tank, described by its name, its fuel efficiency (kilometres per litre) and the capacity of its tank.

The class keeps track of the fuel in the tank: the car can be refuelled (never above the tank capacity) and driven (only if there is enough fuel for the whole distance). It can also report its range and whether it is running on the fuel reserve.

    • canTravel

      public boolean canTravel(double distance)
      Checks whether the car has enough fuel to travel a distance.

      distance - the distance to travel, in km

      true if the range of the car is at least distance, false otherwise

    • drive

      public void drive(double distance)
      Drives the car for a distance and consumes the corresponding fuel (distance / efficiency litres). If there is not enough fuel for the whole distance, the car does not move and no fuel is consumed.
      Parameters:
      distance - the distance to drive, in km

    • getRange

      public double getRange()
      Returns the range of the car, that is how many kilometres it can still travel with the fuel in the tank.
      Returns:
      the range, in km (efficiency * fuelLiters)

    • isOnReserve

      public boolean isOnReserve()
      Checks whether the car is running on the fuel reserve, that is whether the fuel in the tank is 5% of the capacity or less.
      Returns:
      true if the car is on reserve, false otherwise

    • fillUp

      public double fillUp(double addedFuel)
      Adds fuel to the tank and returns the new fuel level. If the added fuel would overflow the tank, the tank is filled exactly up to its capacity. If the tank is already full nothing changes.
      Parameters:
      addedFuel - the litres of fuel to add
      Returns:
      the litres of fuel in the tank after filling up

    • refuel

      public void refuel(double quantity)
      Refuels the car with a quantity of fuel. If the quantity would overflow the tank, the tank is filled exactly up to its capacity.
      Parameters:
      quantity - the litres of fuel to add

    • consumesLess

      true if this car consumes less than other, false otherwise
